snippet.title: Dragon Up! Together Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4772980/Dragon_Up_Together/

Jump, climb, and glide your way through dangerous challenges in this co-op dragon adventure. Young and baby dragons must work together using their unique strengths to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and reach new heights... Just make sure not to fall. Can you help them find their way home?
